status: Implemented in Refraction Hall at 1.35x scale; difficulty awaits playtesting
coordinate_system: Top-down arbitrary units, positive y is north; all horizontal optics share a height
emitter: Directly overhead; vertical input into the starting prism
rules: The starting prism rotates around its vertical incoming beam; every horizontal departure is a 90-degree bend.
Portable prisms rotate only in the horizontal plane and always turn by 90 degrees.
Empty sockets transmit straight through; inserted prisms intercept the beam.
Each lens mount holds at most one lens; unmounted lenses do not affect the beam.
Yellow plus blue makes green in either order, using an explicit magical color rule.
The receiver accepts a green beam from any horizontal direction; no directional hood is required.
